facts: Independent quantum-industry tracker records Infleqtion's September 24 benchmark as 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale using 80 physical qubits.
The same tracker records corrected Q2 2026 revenue of approximately $13.5M and FY2026 guidance of approximately $45.1M after the August revenue-recognition correction.
Tracker identifies Infleqtion as a neutral-atom computing company with computing, clocks, sensing and RF-sensing activities.
Independent filing analysis reports H1 2026 revenue of about $23.4M and net loss of about $54.4M.
It reports government customers represented 89% of revenue and the largest customer represented 74% of six-month revenue, evidencing material customer concentration.
It reports June 30 liquidity of about $59.3M cash plus $522.5M available-for-sale securities and about $22.5M remaining performance obligations.

factors.observation: Independent filing analysis corroborates strong top-line growth alongside operating-scale losses and material customer concentration.
Independent industry tracking records the September 24 30-logical-qubit benchmark, a concrete technical milestone beyond the packet's earlier forward target.
Liquidity is substantial, but revenue concentration and continued losses remain material execution risks; commercialization durability therefore remains conditional on broader customer conversion.

risks.risk: Government customers represented 89% of H1 revenue and one customer represented 74%, creating concentration and contract-timing exposure.
Independent evidence corroborates large H1 net losses despite revenue growth; technical milestones do not by themselves prove scalable unit economics.

contradictions.contradiction: The earlier packet treated 30 logical qubits as a forward 2026 objective; an independent tracker now records achievement on September 24. This reduces technical-milestone uncertainty but does not resolve commercial economics.
contradictions.recommendedDisposition: update technical milestone evidence; retain commercialization/economic uncertainty

unknowns: Independent reproduction details and workload-level economic advantage of the 30-logical-qubit benchmark remain unverified here.
Durability of revenue after concentrated government programs and normalized post-correction margins remains Alpha-owned.
recommendation: Alpha should reuse the independent concentration/liquidity facts for risk and data-confidence evidence and incorporate the September 24 technical milestone without treating it as proof of commercial quantum advantage.
